issues.title: 'I miss my home': Cambodians displaced by conflict start over
issues.title_en: 'I miss my home': Cambodians displaced by conflict start over
issues.summary: BANTEAY MEANCHEY, Cambodia — More than 3,000 new identical houses rise in a grid formation from a Cambodian plain not far from the Thai border, but most of the residents, displaced by conflict, just want to return home.
